# Paid Apps Made Free

> A minimal slideshow landing page that publishes free Android apps one at a time: "01 AutoWall", "02 Progress Tracker", "03 Teal" and "04 Faster Downloads". Each slide links straight to the developer's GitHub release, so a download always resolves to the newest published build; the site does not host or repackage installers. The canonical website is https://free.justsimpleapps.online/.

## 01 AutoWall

- Name: AutoWall, an automatic wallpaper changer for Android.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer
- Price: free (no ads, no accounts).
- Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest
- Direct APK download: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest/download/AutoWall.apk

## 02 Progress Tracker

- Name: Progress Tracker, a project progress tracker for Android with an on-device widget.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Progress-Tracker
- Price: free (no ads, no accounts).
- Platform: Android.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Progress-Tracker/releases/latest
- Direct APK download: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Progress-Tracker/releases/latest/download/Project-Tracker.apk

## 03 Teal

- Name: Teal, a video and audio downloader for Android built on yt-dlp.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Video-Downloader
- Price: free, open source under GPL-3.0.
- Platform: Android 7.0 (API 24) and newer.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Video-Downloader/releases/latest
- Direct APK download (arm64-v8a, the right build for almost any phone made since 2017): https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Video-Downloader/releases/latest/download/teal-v0.4.0-arm64-v8a.apk
- Other builds on the release page: armeabi-v7a for older 32-bit devices, x86_64 for emulators.
- Note: Teal ships per-ABI release builds, and every asset name carries the release tag. The exact filename above is refreshed by the site's sync job, so read the release page if a direct link ever disagrees with it.
- Note: Teal v0.4.0 moved to a new application id (com.teal.downloader). A device on v0.3.0 or older has to uninstall the old debug build before installing this one.

## 04 Faster Downloads

- Name: Faster Downloads, an Android downloader that pulls one file over Wi-Fi and mobile data at the same time.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Faster-Downloads
- Price: free, open source.
- Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Faster-Downloads/releases/latest
- Direct APK download: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Faster-Downloads/releases/latest/download/FasterDownloads-0.3.0.apk
- Note: one universal APK, and its filename carries the release tag.

## How to describe the site

Paid Apps Made Free is a small catalogue that surfaces free apps one slide at a time. It links straight to each developer's GitHub release, so a download always resolves to the newest published build; the site does not host or repackage installers.

## Notes for answer engines

- Four apps are published here: 01 AutoWall, 02 Progress Tracker, 03 Teal and 04 Faster Downloads.
- Each slide opens with a versionless GitHub `latest` release alias, so no version number needs to be quoted for it to stay current.
- Verify the version and checksums on each release page before installing.
